newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - Dow rally fails to inspire technicians.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dow rally fails to inspire technicians.

text.p: Despite the sharp rally in the Dow industrials on Thursday, U.S. stocks could be poised for at least a near-term pullback, technical analysts said.

Wary chart watchers held up recent stock volatility and Thursday's advance, which was dominated by large upturns in a handful of Dow stocks, as an indication the Wall Street rally could be losing steam.
"Short-term the market still wants to go up but we don't think it has too much gas," said Ken Tower, technical analyst at UST Securities.
